name: Umpqua National Forest
policyReason: Dogs are welcome; keep them on a 6-ft leash or under control by day.
summary: Dogs are welcome; keep them on a 6-ft leash or under control by day.

excerpts.quote: Please follow the guidelines below to ensure your pets remain welcome to visit the Forest in the future:

dogRules.text: By day keep dogs on a leash of 6 ft or less or otherwise under control.
Leave vicious or unusually noisy dogs at home.
